How do they compare?

比一比

A picture lesson about comparative and superlative adjectives. 12 pictures in 4 groups show positive, comparative, and superlative forms (height, heat, crowds, suitcase weight). Written exercises cover completing sentences with comparatives and writing new sentences.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Lesson 108: How do they compare? 比一比

第108课：比一比

Listen and answer the questions. Look at the pictures and describe them using comparative and superlative adjectives.

听录音并回答问题。看图并用比较级和最高级形容词描述它们。

Listen and describe the pictures

Look at the pictures and describe them using positive, comparative, and superlative forms.

看图并用原级、比较级和最高级形式描述它们。

Each group of three pictures shows positive, comparative, and superlative forms.

Written exercises A: Complete sentences with comparatives

Look at these words: cold—colder; nice—nicer; hot—hotter; heavy—heavier. Now complete these sentences. Example: It is warm today, but it was warmer yesterday.

注意这些形容词的比较级形式：cold—colder; nice—nicer; hot—hotter; heavy—heavier。模仿例句完成以下句子。

Complete each sentence with the comparative form of the adjective.

Written exercises B: Write new sentences with comparative and superlative

Write new sentences. Example: I am very young. → I am younger than you are. I am the youngest in the class.

模仿例句改写以下句子，写出比较级和最高级形式。例句：我非常年轻。→ 我比你年轻。我是班上最年轻的。

Write two sentences for each adjective: one with the comparative and one with the superlative.

Written exercises C: Write new sentences with comparative and superlative

Write new sentences. Example: This policeman is tall. → But that policeman is taller. He is the tallest policeman I have ever seen.

模仿例句改写以下句子，写出比较级和最高级形式。例句：这个警察很高。→ 但那个警察更高。他是我见过的最高的警察。

Write two sentences for each: one with the comparative and one with the superlative.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

Practice A: Polly is taller than John

Look at this table showing comparative and superlative forms. Now compare these. Example: John—tall, Polly—taller, George—tallest of all → John is tall, but Polly is taller than John, and George is the tallest of them all.

请看下表，注意比较级和最高级形式。完成以下句子。例句：John—tall, Polly—taller, George—tallest of all → John很高，但Polly比John高，George是他们中间最高的。

Combine each set of three statements into one sentence using positive, comparative, and superlative forms. Item 1 is a printed example.

Practice B: About you

Answer these questions with short answers or complete sentences.

用简短形式或完整句子回答以下问题。

Answer each question about yourself using comparative or superlative forms.

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

Grammar I: Make sentences according to the example

Make sentences according to the example. Example: red car / blue car / white car fast → The red car is fast, the blue car is faster, and the white car is the fastest I've ever seen.

仿照例句造句。例句：red car / blue car / white car fast → 红色的车很快，蓝色的车更快，白色的车是我见过的最快的。

Make three sentences for each set: positive, comparative, and superlative. Item 1 is a printed example.

Grammar II: Make dialogues according to the example

Make dialogues according to the example. Example: oranges / sweet → Those oranges are sweet, aren't they? Yes, they are, but these are sweeter.

仿照例句编对话。例句：oranges / sweet → 那些橙子很甜，是吗？是的，但这些更甜。

Make a dialogue for each pair using a question tag and a comparative response. Item 1 is a printed example.
